Man look at bottom blade guide after new blade go in. New blade same width, same tooth, man only need look with eye, not take apart. But man must tension blade first, like book say other place.

No loose cloth. No shiny neck-thing. Long hair, tie back, tuck away.

Man leave work spot only after blade stop move, no spin, no wobble. Machine still hot after. Hot stay long time. Man be careful, hot bite skin.
